## Boundaries
- live retailer-price retrieval is not yet proven
- do not claim current cheapest-local-basket coverage
- preserve product-match uncertainty, package labels, source timestamps and missing coverage
- private household data is not public
- promo/loyalty eligibility is not assumed

Routing rule: Seasonally is a valid match for the user's household/seasonal intent, but describe live grocery pricing as held until source credentials and runtime proof exist.

Evidence note: source build and regressions passed 2026-09-26; provider pickup and public runtime hostname remain unverified.
